scenes.text: The hotel had twelve rooms and eleven guests.
scenes.art_prompt: a lonely lighthouse on a black cliff at night, beam sweeping the sea, heavy fog, ominous

scenes.text: The night clerk counted the keys every evening. Eleven. Always eleven.
scenes.art_prompt: an open handwritten logbook on a wooden desk, single oil lamp, long shadows
an empty coastal village at dusk, no people, curtains moving, unsettling calm
a staircase descending into darkness, faint light below, damp stone walls
a reflection in a dark window that does not match the room, horror

scenes.text: Follow for more Quiet Horror Files.
scenes.art_prompt: a lighthouse gone dark at the edge of a storm, waves heavy, final dread
